title: Potencializando Competências: O Impacto do Pensamento Computacional em Jovens Participantes de um Curso Formativo Strengthening skills: the impact of computational thinking onyoung participants in a training course Potencializando competências: o impacto do pensamento computacional em jovens participantes de um curso formativo
text_snippet: Potencializando Competências: O Impacto do Pensamento Computacional em Jovens Participantes de um Curso Formativo Strengthening skills: the impact of computational thinking onyoung participants in a training course Potencializando competências: o impacto do pensamento computacional em jovens participantes de um curso formativo Computational thinking involves systematizing, representing, analyzing and solving problems with the help of computer science strategies. This skill allows for finding creative solutions and communicating ideas effectively, making it a fundamental skill for success today. The aim of this study was to evaluate the effectiveness of the SHIFT course at the Center for Education and Technology at Atitus Education in the development of computational thinking in 59 Brazilian students. This ability was assessed with the Reduced Computational Thinking Test and the data were analyzed with the Wilcoxon test and descriptive statistics. The results showed that the SHIFT course was effective in promoting the computational thinking skills of the young participants, with a remarkable impact considering the small sample size. It will be critical to invest in further research to consolidate and extend these findings. title: Diseñar para observar, observar para transformar: Aula Invertida y desarrollo de competencias en ingeniería Designing for Observation, Observing for Transformation: Flipped Classroom and Competency Development in Engineering
text_snippet: Diseñar para observar, observar para transformar: Aula Invertida y desarrollo de competencias en ingeniería Designing for Observation, Observing for Transformation: Flipped Classroom and Competency Development in Engineering This article presents the validation of an observation instrument designed to assess the implementation of the Flipped Classroom model in engineering programs, from a competency-based approach and within the TPACK conceptual framework. The instrument includes necessary and desirable criteria organized into three pedagogical phases (before, during, and after class) and a cross-cutting dimension focused on the use of ICT. Validation was carried out across seven engineering courses at UTN-FRRe, combining expert judgment, empirical application, and internal consistency analysis. The results reveal a partial implementation of the model, with strengths in the reorganization of instructional time and weaknesses in personalized follow-up and post-class consolidation. The validated instrument stands as a useful tool for improving teaching practices based on the flipped classroom approach and situated learning in technological contexts.

As results, two main categories were had, the first of them called uses of gamification, starting with the subcategories elements involved and self-regulation of learning, the second being the development of digital competences, having as a subcategory link with the professional profile. title: Patrones de desempeño docente en Educación a Distancia utilizando aprendizaje automático Teaching Performance Patterns in Distance Education Using Machine Learning
text_snippet: Patrones de desempeño docente en Educación a Distancia utilizando aprendizaje automático Teaching Performance Patterns in Distance Education Using Machine Learning The rapid expansion of distance education has driven the adoption of learning platforms that generate vast volumes of data; however, these data often go unanalyzed, risking the loss of valuable insights. This study profiles virtual instructors on the UAEMéx SEDUCA platform using machine learning within the CRISP-DM framework. A quantitative analysis of 1,041 records and 24 variables extracted from the platform’s teaching performance report was conducted. Preprocessing involved data cleaning, K-NN imputation, and outlier detection. For descriptive analysis, K-means and Hierarchical Clustering was applied and validated with silhouette scores; the predictive phase employed a Random Forest classifier optimized with GridSearchCV and validated via confusion matrix and cross-validation. Three instructor profiles were identified—minimal interaction (15 %), moderate interaction (66 %), and intensive interaction (19 %). The most influential predictors were total graded activities and the percentage of on-time submitted evidence, whereas features such as email exchanges and student count proved less relevant. title: SwipTesting – Una herramienta de testing para la enseñanza de Prolog SwipTesting – A testing tool for teaching Prolog
text_snippet: SwipTesting – Una herramienta de testing para la enseñanza de Prolog SwipTesting – A testing tool for teaching Prolog This paper presents the development of a software verification and validation tool focused on the Prolog logic programming language, specifically designed for educational contexts. The project arose from the lack of a functional testing framework in the course "Logic for Computer Science" at the Universidad Nacional del Sur, which affects the quality and efficiency of grading students' work. The tool facilitates the automated creation and execution of test cases, allowing teachers to save time in validating students' programs. It features a user-friendly graphical interface and a console mode, following the Model-View-Presenter architecture to ensure clear separation of responsibilities and ease of maintenance. Additionally, it allows for the storage and comparison of the obtained results with the expected ones in structured formats such as JSON. The implementation has shown key benefits, significantly reducing evaluation time and providing detailed feedback to students. The developed tool is distributed freely.

title: Personalized learning with educational recommender systems, ontology networks, and educator-in-the-loop Enseñanza personalizada con sistemas de recomendación educativos, redes de ontologías y docente-in-the-loop
text_snippet: Personalized learning with educational recommender systems, ontology networks, and educator-in-the-loop Enseñanza personalizada con sistemas de recomendación educativos, redes de ontologías y docente-in-the-loop This paper examines the role of Information and Communication Technologies (ICT) in education, focusing on challenges like the digital divide and the rise of generative AI. While these technologies expand learning opportunities, they also deepen inequalities, underscoring the need for inclusive strategies. Personalized teaching, supported by Educational Recommender Systems (ERS), tailors’ instruction to student needs, yet many ERS prioritize efficiency over pedagogy. The Teacher-in-the-Loop (TITL) approach addresses this by integrating educators’ expertise, ensuring context-aware recommendations. This study proposes a Framework for Personalized Teaching that combines Ontology-driven networks with ERS and TITL to enhance adaptability and inclusivity. Through a case study and literature review, it explores how teacher involvement in ERS can better address student diversity. By advancing ethical and pedagogically sound recommender systems, this research contributes to the global discourse on equitable, high-quality education that balances technological advancements with human-centered teaching.

title: Necesidades formativas de los docentes en el Aprendizaje Basado en Proyectos Training Needs of Teachers in Project-Based Learning
text_snippet: Necesidades formativas de los docentes en el Aprendizaje Basado en Proyectos Training Needs of Teachers in Project-Based Learning The study aims to analyze the training needs of teachers in Project-Based Learning (PBL) in the Computer Science program at the Universidad Nacional de Loja, 2025. A quantitative methodology was used, with a non-experimental, descriptive, and cross-sectional design. In addition, a survey technique was used, and the instrument applied was the FORIMPRA questionnaire, previously validated by expert judgment and factor analysis. The population consisted of 18 teachers from the degree program. Data analysis was performed using descriptive statistics with R software, and the Shapiro-Wilk test was applied to determine the type of correlation between dimensions, opting for Spearman's coefficient. The results showed that the dimension with the lowest score was teacher training (mean = 2.40), followed by methodological implementation (2.62), while classroom practice obtained the highest mean (2.72). Likewise, the correlations between dimensions were moderate and positive, highlighting the relationship between training and classroom practice (r = 0.59). title: La carrera de los investigadores de posdoctorado en una universidad federal brasileña The career of postdoctoral researchers at a Brazilian federal university
text_snippet: La carrera de los investigadores de posdoctorado en una universidad federal brasileña The career of postdoctoral researchers at a Brazilian federal university The main objective of this study was to analyze the perceived influence of postdoctoral studies at the Federal University of the State of Rio de Janeiro (UNIRIO), in a ‘before’/’after’ scenario, on the scientific and technological production of its researchers, in the light of the Knowledge Spiral theory. In the light of the Knowledge Spiral theory, previously neglected dimensions can be considered in a future evaluation model. A census computation of the scientific and technological productions of researchers from UNIRIO’s Stricto Sensu postgraduate system was carried out. These researchers have done postdoctoral work throughout their history in order to analyze the production scenarios before and after the internship. The results indicate that recent doctoral graduates had lower technological and scientific productions immediately after their postdoctoral studies. title: Dimensiones y categorías de las TIC para la formación inicial docente en el siglo XXI: principales aportes y actualizaciones para el campo educativo Dimensions and categories of ICT for initial teacher training in the 21st century: main contributions and updates to the educational field

The aim was to update the dimensions and categories that define teachers’ digital competence in response to 21st-century educational changes. Using a qualitative content analysis approach, ten reference documents (MINEDUC, UNESCO, ISTE, and OECD) were reviewed, selected for their representativeness, recency, and regulatory relevance. The analysis identified 29 categories grouped into six dimensions: basic ICT training, information management, digital citizenship, communicator and collaborator, designer-innovator, and appropriation of virtual learning environments. These dimensions do not replicate previous frameworks but reorganize them, incorporating digital citizenship and virtual environments as emerging post-pandemic components. title: Impacto del COIL en competenciascolaborativas en la formación inicialdocente: Evidencia de aprendizajecooperativo en contextos internacionales Impact of COIL on collaborative skills in initial teacher training: Evidence of cooperative learning in international contexts.
text_snippet: Impacto del COIL en competenciascolaborativas en la formación inicialdocente: Evidencia de aprendizajecooperativo en contextos internacionales Impact of COIL on collaborative skills in initial teacher training: Evidence of cooperative learning in international contexts. In a context of increasing internationalization, institutions face the challenge of strengthening collaborative skills in intercultural and digital environments. This study aimed to analyze the impact of a Collaborative Online Learning (COIL) experience on the development of collaborative skills in initial teacher training students from institutions in Chile and Spain. A quantitative approach was adopted, with a single-group quasi-experimental design and pre- and post-test measurements. The sample consisted of 65 students who participated in five weeks of synchronous and asynchronous collaborative activities mediated by technology. Data collection was carried out using a validated cooperative learning questionnaire with high internal consistency (α= 0.941). The data were analyzed using descriptive and inferential statistics, incorporating correlations. Although the instrument measured cooperative learning, the COIL design promoted intercultural inferences via transnational interaction. title: Estudio de las interacciones entre profesores y estudiantes en entornos digitales en el marco de continuidad pedagógica en contexto de cuarentena Study of interactions between professors and students in digital environments within the framework of pedagogical continuity in a quarantine context
text_snippet: Estudio de las interacciones entre profesores y estudiantes en entornos digitales en el marco de continuidad pedagógica en contexto de cuarentena Study of interactions between professors and students in digital environments within the framework of pedagogical continuity in a quarantine context Following the interruption of face-to-face classes due to the COVID-19 pandemic, higher education institutions adapted their courses and were required to use digital technologies to mediate part of their educational offerings in order to support students during the emergency. This work analyzes the educational crisis that emerged as a result of the pandemic, particularly in higher education, following the suspension of in-person classes. Although most instructors were not prepared for online education, they demonstrated commitment and determination by striving to understand what it meant to teach remotely. They used fully online learning environments, attempted to create engaging and relevant content, and experimented with digital assessment methods. Choosing the safest approach and avoiding major risks, most simply replicated their traditional classroom practices within new digital environments. title: Actitudes hacia la educación virtual encontexto de pandemia: Estudio comparativoentre facultades de una universidad privadade Mendoza, Argentina The Attitudes towards virtual education in pandemic context: Comparative study between faculties of a private university in Mendoza, Argentina
text_snippet: Actitudes hacia la educación virtual encontexto de pandemia: Estudio comparativoentre facultades de una universidad privadade Mendoza, Argentina The Attitudes towards virtual education in pandemic context: Comparative study between faculties of a private university in Mendoza, Argentina The context of the Covid-19 pandemic forced the university educational system for two years to transform its face-to-face classes into virtual classes, through Information and Communication Technologies (ICT). General Objective: To evaluate the attitudes towards the use of ICT in university teachers from the Faculty of Economic and Legal Sciences (FCEyJ) and the Faculty of Psychology (FP) of a private university in Mendoza. Results: in all components of favorable attitudes towards ICT, both FCEyJ and FP teachers expressed “agree”. On the contrary, they “disagreed” regarding unfavorable attitudes towards ICT, in the three components. title: Análise qualitativa das variáveis influenciadoras da evasão escolar no ifsul charqueadas-rs Qualitative Analysis of the Influencing Variables of School Dropout at IFSUL Charqueadas-RS
text_snippet: Análise qualitativa das variáveis influenciadoras da evasão escolar no ifsul charqueadas-rs Qualitative Analysis of the Influencing Variables of School Dropout at IFSUL Charqueadas-RS School dropout in higher education institutions is a multifactorial phenomenon involving socioeconomic, academic, and institutional aspects. This study qualitatively analyzes the variables influencing school dropout at IFSUL Campus Charqueadas-RS, using data on academic performance, attendance, socioeconomic factors, and institutional perceptions. The most impactful variables include socioeconomic conditions and student motivation, while pedagogical practices and frustration with expectations are also significant. Suggested strategies include student assistance policies, curricular flexibility, and psychopedagogical support. The analysis highlights the importance of an inclusive environment and institutional policies to reduce dropout rates and improve academic retention.

title: Markdown: El lenguaje de marcado para tomar apuntes Markdown: The markup language for taking notes
text_snippet: Markdown: El lenguaje de marcado para tomar apuntes Markdown: The markup language for taking notes This paper evaluates the applicability of Markdown as a tool for creating digital academic notes. An analysis of Markdown syntax was conducted and a Python prototype was developed to convert .md files to HTML. The results show the feasibility of creating notes that, when converted from Markdown to HTML, are remotely accessible for more efficient consultation. It is concluded that Markdown is an efficient alternative for note management and publication, enabling customization and remote accessibility.

title: Impacto de la Enseñanza sobre Inteligencia Artificial y Pensamiento Computacional en la Educación Básica - Revisión Bibliográfica Impact of Teaching about Artificial Intelligence and Computational Thinking in Basic Education – Literature Review Impacto do Ensino sobre Inteligência Artificial e Pensamento Computacional na Educação Básica - Revisão Bibliográfica
text_snippet: Impacto de la Enseñanza sobre Inteligencia Artificial y Pensamiento Computacional en la Educación Básica - Revisión Bibliográfica Impact of Teaching about Artificial Intelligence and Computational Thinking in Basic Education – Literature Review Impacto do Ensino sobre Inteligência Artificial e Pensamento Computacional na Educação Básica - Revisão Bibliográfica In recent years, Artificial Intelligence (AI) has made significant advancements, creating an interest in the application of AI in basic education, particularly in the development of Computational Thinking, which includes skills such as critical thinking, analysis, problem decomposition, and abstraction. The presented research explores the bibliography related to this impact, especially following the inclusion of the Brazilian Computing standard in the National Common Curricula. In spite of this interest, there is a need for more quantitative and qualitative research in the area, and further research is proposed, based on a specific didactic sequence to be applied in two classes in the first year of high school. It is expected that the methodology detailed may contribute to ways through which AI can be integrated into the school curriculum to develop Computational Thinking.

title: Aceptación e integración de ChatGPT en la educación universitaria: análisis de percepciones docentes en la carrera de Ingeniería Agronómica y estudiantiles en la asignatura Microbiología Agrícola y de los Bioinsumos de la UNNOBA Acceptance and Integration of ChatGPT in Higher Education: Analysis of Faculty Perceptions in the Agronomic Engineering Program and Student Perceptions in the Agricultural Microbiology and Bioinputs Course at UNNOBA
text_snippet: Aceptación e integración de ChatGPT en la educación universitaria: análisis de percepciones docentes en la carrera de Ingeniería Agronómica y estudiantiles en la asignatura Microbiología Agrícola y de los Bioinsumos de la UNNOBA Acceptance and Integration of ChatGPT in Higher Education: Analysis of Faculty Perceptions in the Agronomic Engineering Program and Student Perceptions in the Agricultural Microbiology and Bioinputs Course at UNNOBA This study explores the acceptance and integration of ChatGPT as an educational tool in higher education, based on a case study conducted at the National University of Northwestern Buenos Aires (UNNOBA). A practical activity was implemented with students in the Agricultural Microbiology and Bioinputs course, along with a survey for faculty in the Agronomic Engineering program. Results show that students had a positive perception of ChatGPT in terms of usefulness, accuracy, and ease of use, emphasizing its role in concept comprehension, critical thinking, and teamwork. Faculty members, however, were more cautious, with lower usage frequency and concerns related to plagiarism and technological dependence. Despite this, they acknowledged the tool’s potential and expressed interest in training. title: Validación de contenido de CHAEA mediante juicio de expertos con el uso de Inteligencia Artificial Generativa Content validity of CHAEA through expert judgment supported by Generative Artificial Intelligence
text_snippet: Validación de contenido de CHAEA mediante juicio de expertos con el uso de Inteligencia Artificial Generativa Content validity of CHAEA through expert judgment supported by Generative Artificial Intelligence Learning styles describe how individuals process and assimilate information, influencing teaching strategies and methodologies. The Honey-Alonso Learning Styles Questionnaire (CHAEA) is a widely used tool at the university level in Spanish-speaking contexts to assess these styles. However, its validity has been questioned when applied across different cultural contexts. This research explores the use of Generative Artificial Intelligences (GenAI) as expert judges in the content validation of CHAEA. The article synthesizes previous findings as well as the expert judgment conducted. The results show an excellent level of agreement between judges and with the original CHAEA structure. In addition, they demonstrate the feasibility of using GenAI as expert judges, highlighting their potential to complement human judgment. This work contributes to the analysis of learning styles and proposes new perspectives for the validation of educational measurement instruments.

title: Avaliação dos Estilos de Aprendizagem VARK no Contexto de um MOOC Aplicado de Forma Híbrida no Ensino Técnico Evaluation of VARK Learning Styles in the Context of a MOOC Applied in a Hybrid Way in Technical Education
text_snippet: Avaliação dos Estilos de Aprendizagem VARK no Contexto de um MOOC Aplicado de Forma Híbrida no Ensino Técnico Evaluation of VARK Learning Styles in the Context of a MOOC Applied in a Hybrid Way in Technical Education Learning styles represent individuals' preferences in assimilating knowledge, encompassing sensory modalities and cognitive strategies. A widely used model is VARK, which classifies styles into Visual, Auditory, Reading/Writing, and Kinesthetic. Therefore, this study aimed to evaluate the association between VARK styles and students' academic performance, gender and age, in the context of a MOOC course applied in a hybrid format in a technical course in Informatics. This applied, exploratory and quantitative research had the participation of 59 students over three different periods, whose data were collected through an electronic form with the VARK questionnaire and from the academic records of the MOOC virtual learning environment. For the statistical analysis of the data, the Kruskal-Wallis test and Fisher's exact test were used. As a result, the Kinesthetic style was observed to be predominant among the students. However, no statistically significant associations were identified between the VARK styles and the variables of interest previously mentioned.

title: Proposta de sequência didática para o ensino de Temperatura e Calor com Python Proposal for a didactic sequence for teaching Temperature and Heat with Python
text_snippet: Proposta de sequência didática para o ensino de Temperatura e Calor com Python Proposal for a didactic sequence for teaching Temperature and Heat with Python Several researches seek to promote improvements in Physics teaching through the insertion of new methodologies, mainly those linked to Digital Information and Communication Technologies. In this work, based on Ausubel's theory of Meaningful Learning, a proposal for two classes on thermometric scales and sensible heat is presented using the Python programming language, which can be applied even if the teacher does not know it. It is proposed that classes take place in a laboratory with computers and a whiteboard and that the teacher addresses the conceptual content in his/her own way, although approaches and strategies for socialization, discussion and feedback are suggested, and that, when solving exercises, students use Python as a tool to check their answers. In this way, it is understood, based on related research, that difficulties regarding the use of the computer and a computational language are mitigated and that the use of Python collaborates with the learning of Physics, also contributing to the scientific and technological literacy of students. students.

journal_name: Revista Iberoamericana de Tecnología en Educación y Educación en Tecnología
title: Incorporações de Guias de Tutorias via Inferência no Aprendizado On-line Embeddings of Tutoring Guides via Inference in E-Learning
text_snippet: Incorporações de Guias de Tutorias via Inferência no Aprendizado On-line Embeddings of Tutoring Guides via Inference in E-Learning Neste artigo, propomos uma estratégia para incorporar guias de ajuda, via inferência, em tutoria de estudantes no aprendizado on-line. Desenvolvemos um módulo de Sistema de Tutoria Inteligente (STI) que integra a atuação de tutores humanos na construção desses guias. Esses guias, baseados em tutorias realizadas sobre o uso de uma plataforma de Rede Social Educativa (RSE), foram incorporados por meio de modelos de Processamento de Linguagem Natural (PLN). Utilizamos um modelo híbrido, retroalimentado por tutores humanos, que combina intervenções humanas e artificiais. Esse modelo gera um espaço de hipóteses para capturar o significado semântico e contextual de perguntas difíceis, oferecendo respostas com base no conhecimento prévio dos tutores. Testes preliminares indicam que os guias de ajuda, desenvolvidos por tutores em momentos off-line, orientam o modelo durante o treinamento, utilizando técnicas de destilação de conhecimento para respostas no aprendizado on-line. Os resultados demonstraram que a estratégia proposta oferece tutorias efetivas, com menor percepção de complexidade e alta satisfação, ao personalizar a experiência com base nas necessidades de tutoria identificadas.

journal_name: Revista Iberoamericana de Tecnología en Educación y Educación en Tecnología
title: Aprendizado personalizado de idiomas com microinterações gamificadas e sensíveis à localização Personalized language learning with gamified microinteractions and location sensitivity
text_snippet: Aprendizado personalizado de idiomas com microinterações gamificadas e sensíveis à localização Personalized language learning with gamified microinteractions and location sensitivity The popularization of mobile devices encouraged the development of various applications to help language learning. Although these apps employ different techniques to support autonomous learning, many still do not incorporate context sensitivity as a pedagogical differentiator. This resource is fundamental, because it encourages learner autonomy and promotes a more meaningful learning experience. In this scenario, the present paper aims to explore this approach and propose an application for Android and iOS that integrates user's location context with gamification strategies and microinteractions, seeking to enrich the language learning process. To achieve this goal, a literature review and an analysis of existing market products and relevant academic work were conducted. As a result, it was possible to develop the conceptual model, software artifacts, and the database structure. Finally, the solution was validated through the Think Aloud technique. The results indicate that the product received positive feedback from participants, highlighting the importance of using location context for better content assimilation and the ease of use of the application.

journal_name: Revista Iberoamericana de Tecnología en Educación y Educación en Tecnología
title: Desenho e Validação Psicométrica do Questionário de Percepção dos Professores do Uso de IA na Educação (TPU-AIED-Q) Design and Psychometric Validation of the Teachers' Perception of the Use of AI in Education Questionnaire (TPU-AIED-Q)
text_snippet: Desenho e Validação Psicométrica do Questionário de Percepção dos Professores do Uso de IA na Educação (TPU-AIED-Q) Design and Psychometric Validation of the Teachers' Perception of the Use of AI in Education Questionnaire (TPU-AIED-Q) The study aimed to psychometrically validate the Teachers' Perception of the Use of AI in Education Questionnaire (TPU-AIED-Q), an instrument designed to assess teachers' perceptions of AI application in the educational context. The research involved 143 teachers who responded to an electronic form. The KMO and Bartlett's Sphericity tests were applied to verify sample adequacy, and confirmatory factor analysis (CFA) was used to validate the questionnaire's structure. The results indicated four main components with high Cronbach's Alpha values, ensuring the internal consistency of the measures. The study concludes that the TPU-AIED-Q is a valid and reliable instrument for assessing teachers' perceptions of AI use in education.

journal_name: Revista Iberoamericana de Tecnología en Educación y Educación en Tecnología
title: Evaluación del rasgo responsabilidad a través de un videojuego serio de química y matemática Assessment of the responsibility trait through a serious game on chemistry and mathematics
text_snippet: Evaluación del rasgo responsabilidad a través de un videojuego serio de química y matemática Assessment of the responsibility trait through a serious game on chemistry and mathematics This paper presents an exploratory study on the use of the serious video game, Escapados, as a stealth assessment of the responsibility trait, associated with academic performance. A case study involving 36 students from the Agricultural Engineering course of studies at the School of Agriculture, UNLPam, was carried out. The game involves chemistry and mathematics content, and allows recording several performance indicators, such as score, number of errors, time, and use of aids. For the analysis of results, a Principal Components Analysis (PCA) was applied. It showed a correlation among one of the components found, which reflects the performance in the game and the score obtained for the responsibility trait calculated with the Big Five personality questionnaire (BFI). The PCA also allowed establishing four profiles of performance and autonomy in the game. The “efficient and autonomous” student profile represents the highest number with high responsibility, which coincides with what is theoretically expected. The results suggest that the video game Escapados has the potential to be used as a stealth assessment of the responsibility trait.

title: Utilización de la inteligencia artificial para el estudio de las ciencias Artificial intelligence in science learning
text_snippet: Utilización de la inteligencia artificial para el estudio de las ciencias Artificial intelligence in science learning Research and development on generative artificial intelligence, applied in academia, show that chatbots can be valuable aid in promoting personalized learning. In this case, the evolution of a bot's design and application is presented, built in the context of a physics course at the Faculty of Engineering at the University of Buenos Aires. Within a methodological framework of design-based research and action research, it is analyzed the implementation of artificial intelligence in a student’s activity to solve a mechanics problem. The impact of technological advancement on the use of artificial intelligence tools is shown. It is emphasized that the development of “Física.bot” with Agentic-RAG bot provides students and teachers with a reliable tool built with their own sources. The results of its implementation also indicate that students positively value the inclusion of this technology in classes as a learning supplement. Finally, future lines of action are proposed for its use in the Faculty and its relationship with the environment

title: Métodos de estimación de carga académica en entornos virtuales: Una revisión sistemática comparativa entre modalidades en línea, blended y hyflex Methods for Estimating Academic Workload in Virtual Environments: A Systematic Comparative Review Across Online, Blended, and Hyflex Modalities
text_snippet: Métodos de estimación de carga académica en entornos virtuales: Una revisión sistemática comparativa entre modalidades en línea, blended y hyflex Methods for Estimating Academic Workload in Virtual Environments: A Systematic Comparative Review Across Online, Blended, and Hyflex Modalities This systematic review analyzes the methods and criteria used to calculate student academic workload across various educational modalities: online, blended learning, and hyflex. Following the PRISMA methodology, 2,179 initial references were evaluated, of which 28 were analyzed in depth. The results identify three main approaches for calculating academic workload: (1) computational models and standardized calculators such as i-SLT, (2) analysis of interaction data on educational platforms, and (3) self-report surveys on time spent. The evidence demonstrates that the choice of method can explain up to 15% of the variance in results and that the estimated academic workload in blended environments was 62% lower than ECTS-based parameters. The findings reveal that the most effective methods for quantifying academic workload specifically depend on the educational context, requiring a differentiated approach according to the modality. title: Desarrollo de una aplicación de realidad aumentada que integra voz y sonido en el aprendizaje y entrenamiento de colores en el idioma inglés. Development of an augmented reality application that integrates voice and sound in learning and training colors in the English language.
text_snippet: Desarrollo de una aplicación de realidad aumentada que integra voz y sonido en el aprendizaje y entrenamiento de colores en el idioma inglés. Development of an augmented reality application that integrates voice and sound in learning and training colors in the English language. The development of an augmented reality application that integrates the main sound components in a web portal is presented. On one side, voice recognition uses the microphone integrated into a smartphone, and on the other side the component that allows robotic voice interpretation, taking a text entry as a reference; Both functionalities were implemented focusing on the English language with an American accent. Using primitive shapes, a three-dimensional ice cream cone-shaped object was generated, which can change the color of its surface dynamically and interactively with the user. In the event that the user needs to consult the correct pronunciation of a color, the text-to-speech functionality can be used at any time. During the development of the application, a generative artificial intelligence tool was used to develop the programming code in the A-frame language, so relevant aspects found during the interaction in the ChatBot are discussed. title: Antenas fractales: un estudio de caso sobre el transcurso completo de un ciclo de modelización matemática en álgebra lineal Fractal antenna: a case study on the full course of mathematical modeling cycle in linear algebra
text_snippet: Antenas fractales: un estudio de caso sobre el transcurso completo de un ciclo de modelización matemática en álgebra lineal Fractal antenna: a case study on the full course of mathematical modeling cycle in linear algebra This paper presents a case study conducted at a university in Uruguay, where a Computer Engineering student explored Fractal Geometry through the design and performance analysis of fractal antennas based on the Sierpinski triangle iterations 2 and 3. The research began in a linear algebra course that is part of the curriculum for several Engineering programs (Agronomy, Food Engineering, Electronics, Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Telecommunications) and extended into an introductory research project. The study focused on characteristic properties of fractals, such as self-similarity, non-integer fractal dimension, and having an infinite perimeter within a finite area, which facilitated the design of small multiband antennas. From the student’s work, it was observed that interpreting and validating the studied concepts through the analysis of fractal antenna performance completed a modeling cycle, as the findings demonstrated advantages of these antennas over traditional ones. title: Estrategias de enseñanza de la programación concurrente: un estudio de caso sobre el uso de semáforos en un curso de sistemas operativos Teaching strategies for concurrent programming: a case study on the use of semaphores in an operating systems course
text_snippet: Estrategias de enseñanza de la programación concurrente: un estudio de caso sobre el uso de semáforos en un curso de sistemas operativos Teaching strategies for concurrent programming: a case study on the use of semaphores in an operating systems course Learning the concurrent paradigm is complex, and several factors influence it: programming language, prior knowledge, teaching sequence, and strategies. To achieve learning, it is necessary to identify appropriate teaching sequences for learning the paradigm, as well as common errors in building concurrent programs. A teaching sequence focused on working with binary semaphores was used, emphasizing inductive strategies and demonstrations, with special attention paid to the progression of content and practical activities. Based on the assumption that building a concurrent program demonstrates an understanding of the paradigm, the construction of 21 programs that worked with binary semaphores was evaluated. Among those not familiar with the paradigm, poor identification of critical sections was identified as a common error, particularly the inclusion of statements that should not be included. Most students demonstrated mastery of the concurrent paradigm, leading to the conclusion that the applied sequence was adequate.

title: La integración de las TIC en los procesos de superación con profesores noveles para las carreras de ingeniería en el área de ciencias agropecuarias The integration of ICT in the improvement processes with new teachers for engineering careers in the area of ​​agricultural sciences
text_snippet: La integración de las TIC en los procesos de superación con profesores noveles para las carreras de ingeniería en el área de ciencias agropecuarias The integration of ICT in the improvement processes with new teachers for engineering careers in the area of ​​agricultural sciences The novice professors at the Agrarian University of Havana play an important role in ensuring the continuity of university students' education. However, several challenges arise, including issues related to pedagogy and didactics, technology, demographics, population aging, migration, and socioeconomic factors. These obstacles hinder the integration of new technologies into the teaching-learning process, causing traditional teaching methods to persist. The article proposes a postgraduate approach to contributing to the integration of Information and Communication Technologies (ICT) for novice professors entering university teaching. Methods such as modeling, document review, activity analysis, and observation were employed to achieve the proposed objective: integrating ICT into the teaching-learning process for novice professors at the Agrarian University of Havana. The primary achievement was the integration of ICT into the specific didactics of each subject taught by professors in their respective fields. The diploma course "Basic Training for University Professors" was used as the essential pathway

title: Gamificación para el fortalecimiento de competencias básicas en estudiantes de salud Gamification for the Strengthening of Basic Competencies in Health Students
text_snippet: Gamificación para el fortalecimiento de competencias básicas en estudiantes de salud Gamification for the Strengthening of Basic Competencies in Health Students This study examines the effectiveness of gamification using Virtual Learning Objects (VLO) to strengthen basic competencies in Obstetrics and Gynecology students, given the reduction in clinical practice hours caused by the COVID-19 pandemic. Three VLOs with varying complexity levels were designed using the ADDIE method and validated by experts. 69 students participated, divided into control and experimental groups. Competency development was assessed with a standardized test, and student perception was evaluated using the LORI instrument and qualitative feedback. The results showed no statistically significant differences in the development of basic low-complexity competencies between the groups. However, the VLO addressing higher-complexity competencies (vital sign interpretation) showed a statistically significant difference, albeit with a small to moderate effect size, in favor of the experimental group that used the VLO before the face-to-face workshop. Student perception was largely positive, highlighting motivation and usefulness for learning, although areas for improvement in usability and feedback were identified. title: Análisis del impacto de la inteligencia emocional en el rendimiento académico en diferentes áreas educativas en estudiantes de primaria. Un caso de estudio. text_snippet: Análisis del impacto de la inteligencia emocional en el rendimiento académico en diferentes áreas educativas en estudiantes de primaria. Un caso de estudio. Analysis of the impact of emotional intelligence on academic performance in different educational areas in elementary school students. A case study. This study used assessment techniques and methods to explore the impact of emotional intelligence on the academic performance of fourth-grade elementary school students at U.E. Ariel in the Durán canton of Ecuador, specifically in the educational areas of Physical Education and Mathematics. 28 students (13 boys and 15 girls) were included during an evaluation week. In physical education, the topic was the correct starting technique for a race, while in mathematics, natural number operations were covered. Emotional intelligence was assessed using the MESQUITE Emotional Intelligence Test, which classifies students into four levels. Data collection was conducted daily during the experimentation phase, prior to classes and the final test, through questionnaires to ensure efficient and accurate data collection utilizing technological analysis tools. title: Simuladores Virtuales para la Práctica Profesional en Entrevista Psicológica
text_snippet: Simuladores Virtuales para la Práctica Profesional en Entrevista Psicológica Virtual simulation for training allows the recreation of real-life situations in a controlled environment, in which users can interact, acquire new skills, and receive real-time feedback for professional practice. In the field of healthcare education, these programs have enabled clinical training in a safe and controlled environment, providing the opportunity to practice as many times as needed, with the freedom to make mistakes, learn from them, and thus acquire the professional skills required to achieve mastery of the clinical competence demanded by their profession. This paper describes the preliminary results of a study aimed at evaluating the acquisition of professional competencies for clinical interviews in psychology students through the use of virtual simulators, as well as their usability. The results obtained showed positive outcomes in terms of theoretical knowledge acquisition and practical skills in psychological interviewing after completing the simulators. Additionally, they demonstrate a high level of functionality and acceptability among students, proving to be of great utility for competency acquisition and clinical skill practice. title: La inclusión de los NAP de Educación Digital, Programación y Robótica en los diseños curriculares del nivel primario en Argentina The inclusion of the NAP of Digital Education, Programming and Robotics in the curriculum designs of the primary level in Argentina
text_snippet: La inclusión de los NAP de Educación Digital, Programación y Robótica en los diseños curriculares del nivel primario en Argentina The inclusion of the NAP of Digital Education, Programming and Robotics in the curriculum designs of the primary level in Argentina This article is the result of a survey and analysis of the curriculum designs of the primary level of Argentina´s jurisdictions. It presents a research about what kind of presence, selection, organization and sequencing was given to the contents of Digital Education, Programming and Robotics as from the approval of the Priority Learning Cores -NAP EDPR-. An attempt will be made to recognize the relevance of the advance of this federally agreed political-educational definition that proposes a set of knowledge considered unavoidable, while recognizing the diversity of socio-educational realities in each jurisdiction. The purpose of this article arises from the guidelines of this regulation where it is established that the curricular designs must be adapted based on it.

title: Aprendizaje basado en proyectos integrando ciencia de datos en la enseñanza de programación en educación superior Project based learning integrating data sciencie into programming education in higher education
text_snippet: Aprendizaje basado en proyectos integrando ciencia de datos en la enseñanza de programación en educación superior Project based learning integrating data sciencie into programming education in higher education This study analyzes the application of Project-Based Learning (PBL) in programming education. The fundamentals and principles of data science were implemented with engineering students. A methodological strategy was applied that enabled students to acquire knowledge contributing to the development of analytical skills and competencies useful for informed decision-making in their professional and industrial fields. The study considered identifying the main deficiencies of the study group at the beginning of the semester and introduced related topics that allowed them to work with real data from the automotive industry. Specialized software for programming with descriptive statistics was used, which is accessible to any student. The results show a significant improvement in the way students acquire and understand knowledge of descriptive statistics and data analysis, an increase in motivation to carry out activities, and improved academic performance. On the qualitative side, students recognized the importance of this knowledge as added value to their professional training. The study successfully promoted an effective connection between theory and practice.

title: Ruidos en la web Digital Noise
text_snippet: Ruidos en la web Digital Noise This book describes how adolescents access information in the digital age through online searches and social media, highlighting the challenges they face in managing the vast amount of information available on the web in a reflective and critical manner. It addresses issues related to youth culture and learning, with a particular emphasis on teaching how to think, learning how to learn, and evaluating learning processes and pathways. The book focuses on information literacy, which should be promoted and implemented by families, educators, and the State.

title: Book Review: University Revolution: Artificial Intelligence and the Transformation of Learning
text_snippet: Book Review: University Revolution: Artificial Intelligence and the Transformation of Learning This book focuses on the impact of Artificial Intelligence on Education, not only in the classroom but also in the institutional change it is bringing about. It concludes with a vision for the future of Education in an "Ideal University," after analyzing the projections for educational changes over the next 10 years.

title: Recomendação de Objetos de Aprendizagem de áudio e vídeo: uma Revisão Sistemática Recommending Audio and Video Learning Objects: A Systematic Review
text_snippet: Recomendação de Objetos de Aprendizagem de áudio e vídeo: uma Revisão Sistemática Recommending Audio and Video Learning Objects: A Systematic Review Recommending learning objects is an important strategy for teaching the technology area. Personalized recommendation for students is not a trivial task and requires analysis of the themes explored and the types of objects suggested. This research investigated the work on recommending learning objects in terms of audio, video typing and other related types that contribute to supporting the teaching of Computing courses in Brazil. The research analyzes the teaching-learning processes developed, the information filtering techniques used, the tools in the area, other research topics covered, the content made available and the existing repositories of learning objects within the scope of Computing teaching in the Brazilian scenario. This work describes initiatives and approaches aimed at teaching and how recommendations for these types of learning objects can impact the national scenario.

title: Desafíos de Pensamiento Computacional. Taller para diagnosticar y potenciar habilidades en el ingreso universitario Computational Thinking Challenges: A Workshop to Diagnose and Enhance Skills in Incoming University Students
text_snippet: Desafíos de Pensamiento Computacional. Taller para diagnosticar y potenciar habilidades en el ingreso universitario Computational Thinking Challenges: A Workshop to Diagnose and Enhance Skills in Incoming University Students Computational Thinking (CT) has established itself as a key strategy for problem-solving, particularly in fields related to Computer Science. In this context, a disciplinary workshop was developed for incoming students of the Department of Computer Science at the National University of San Luis, aimed at diagnosing the initial state of CT skills and assessing their evolution, anticipating their performance in the first semester courses. The development of Computational Thinking (CT) skills is crucial in introductory Computer Science courses. In 2023, as part of line 3 of the PROICO 03/2720 research project, a disciplinary workshop was proposed to the Department of Computer Science for incoming students to evaluate CT skills. The workshop was conducted virtually and organized into three stages: an initial challenge to assess baseline skills, a synchronous meeting to share results and analyze strategies, and a final challenge to measure progress made. The results indicated that 44% of the students answered between 4 and 5 questions correctly in the initial challenge, while this percentage increased to 54.29% in the final challenge, showing significant improve

title: Búsqueda y selección de información en Internet de adultos que cursan estudios superiores a distancia Search and selection of information on the Internet of adults pursuing higher education at a distance
text_snippet: Búsqueda y selección de información en Internet de adultos que cursan estudios superiores a distancia Search and selection of information on the Internet of adults pursuing higher education at a distance The research addressed the human side of the relationship between andragogy and information and communication technologies (ICTs) in the field of higher education in the virtual or distance modality. This, in a scenario of development, consolidation and expansion of ICTs and the Internet, together with the growing offer of higher education courses in virtual or distance mode. The objectives were to investigate how adult students search for and select information on the Internet, and the criteria for evaluating information sources from the Web. It was possible to demonstrate that the search and selection of information on the network and the evaluation of information sources have an empirical basis, which is not the result of systematic and academic learning in the field of ICTs. This is a challenge for higher education institutions, academics and students, in the sense of including, on a mandatory basis, continuing education workshops, training and improvement in the use of the web, search engines, information search processes on the Internet, and the evaluation of information sources from which data are extracted from cyberspace.
